name: command
title: Command
description: A command palette component built with Dialog and Autocomplete for searching and executing commands.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Command } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';

  type Props = Command.GroupItemsProps & { children?: Snippet };

  let { children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Command.GroupItems data-slot="command-collection" {...restProps}>
  {@render children?.()}
</Command.GroupItems>
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from 'bits-ui';

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    type = 'button',
    ...restProps
  }: DialogPrimitive.TriggerProps = $props();
</script>

<DialogPrimitive.Trigger bind:ref data-slot="command-dialog-trigger" {type} {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from 'bits-ui';

  let { open = $bindable(false), ...restProps }: DialogPrimitive.RootProps = $props();
</script>

<DialogPrimitive.Root bind:open {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
  import { Command } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Command.EmptyProps & { children?: Snippet };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Command.Empty
  class={cn('not-empty:py-6 text-center text-base text-muted-foreground sm:text-sm', className)}
  data-slot="command-empty"
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</Command.Empty>
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
  import { Command } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Command.GroupHeadingProps & { children?: Snippet };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Command.GroupHeading
  class={cn('px-2 py-1.5 font-medium text-muted-foreground text-xs', className)}
  data-slot="command-group-label"
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</Command.GroupHeading>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Command } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Command.GroupProps & { children?: Snippet };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Command.Group class={cn(className)} data-slot="command-group" {...restProps}>
  {@render children?.()}
</Command.Group>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Command } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Command.ItemProps & { children?: Snippet };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Command.Item
  class={cn(
    'flex min-h-8 cursor-default select-none items-center rounded-sm px-2 py-1.5 text-base outline-none data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-selected:bg-accent data-selected:text-accent-foreground data-disabled:opacity-64 sm:min-h-7 sm:text-sm',
    className
  )}
  data-slot="command-item"
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</Command.Item>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Command } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { ScrollArea } from '$lib/components/ui/scroll-area';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Command.ListProps & { children?: Snippet };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Command.List
  class={cn('min-h-0 flex-1 **:data-[slot=scroll-area-viewport]:scroll-py-2', className)}
  data-slot="command-list"
  {...restProps}
>
  <ScrollArea scrollFade scrollbarGutter>
    <Command.Viewport class="not-empty:p-2">
      {@render children?.()}
    </Command.Viewport>
  </ScrollArea>
</Command.List>
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
  import { Command } from 'bits-ui';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Command.SeparatorProps;

  let { class: className, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Command.Separator
  class={cn('my-2 h-px bg-border', className)}
  data-slot="command-separator"
  {...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  interface Props extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
    children?: Snippet;
  }

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<kbd
  class={cn(
    'ms-auto font-medium font-sans text-muted-foreground/72 text-xs tracking-widest',
    className
  )}
  data-slot="command-shortcut"
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</kbd>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Command } from 'bits-ui';
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import { cn } from '$lib/utils';

  type Props = Command.RootProps & { children?: Snippet };

  let { class: className, children, ...restProps }: Props = $props();
</script>

<Command.Root class={cn('flex min-h-0 flex-col', className)} data-slot="command" {...restProps}>
  {@render children?.()}
</Command.Root>
